policy: Preserve historical original bytes and licenses. Private local history is moved opaquely with filesystem renames; no file bodies are inspected, rewritten, deleted, or published.
scope: Archive classification and relocation only; report contents, old comments, embedded paths and original experiment commands remain historical.

verification.method: Before/after metadata inventory for each atomic filesystem rename; no content copies and no new symlinks. Existing archive entries also checked unchanged.
